description: High-performance Room Database clone for C# with Source Generators
releaseNotes:
v0.5.0 — Smart Entity Lifecycle

            New Features:
            - [SoftDelete] Generated DAO Methods:
              Entities marked with [SoftDelete] now get RestoreAsync/Restore and
              HardDeleteAsync/HardDelete generated directly inside their DAO classes.
              This removes the need for RoomDatabase extension methods and makes the feature
              fully compatible with Dependency Injection.

            - [SoftDelete] Automatic Query Filtering:
              All [Query] methods targeting [SoftDelete] entities now automatically inject
              the appropriate filter at prepare-time:
              - deleted_at IS NULL for DateTime-based soft delete
              - is_deleted = 0 for bool-based soft delete
              Soft-deleted rows are transparently excluded from DAO queries by default.

            - [Encrypted] Automatic Decryption:
              Properties marked with [Encrypted] are now automatically decrypted after every
              SELECT query. This works for both single-entity and collection results across
              all concurrency modes, including Parallel and Serialized.
              Manual Decrypt() calls are no longer required.

            - [Auditable] Audit Trail:
              Entities marked with [Auditable] now automatically populate CreatedAt and
              UpdatedAt on Insert and Update. When TrackCreatedBy is enabled, RoomSharp also
              records the creating user through IAuditContext.

            Performance And Stability:
            - Improved internal lifecycle handling for soft-deleted, encrypted, and auditable entities.
            - Better reliability across generated DAO operations and query execution paths.
            - General internal stability improvements in source generation and runtime behavior.

            Fixed:
            - Fixed QueryCache.InvalidateByPrefix() returning void instead of int, which
              caused a compilation error in FluentQuery.InvalidateTableCache().
            - Fixed [Auditable] code generation calling the non-existent
              AuditContext.CurrentUserId property; it now correctly calls
              IAuditContext.GetCurrentUser().
           
            ---
            
            0.4.8
            Improvements:
            - Added IAsyncDisposable to RoomDatabase for proper async cleanup in DI containers (prevents deadlocks with ASP.NET Core).
            - Added ClearAllTablesAsync() async version of ClearAllTables.
            - ClearAllTables now supports all database providers (SQLite, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL) instead of SQLite only.
            - ClearAllTables now uses Dialect.FormatIdentifier() for safe table name quoting.
            - Added CancellationToken parameter to RunInTransaction sync overloads.
            - Adopted Central Package Management (CPM) with lowest compatible dependency versions (8.0.0) to prevent version conflicts with consumer projects.
            
            Fixed:
            - Fixed RetryPolicy.IsTransient() using fragile string matching; now uses DbException type checking with inner exception traversal.
            - Removed duplicated #if/#else blocks in EnsureConnectionOpen and StartAutoCloseMonitor.
            
            0.4.7
            Fixed:
            - Fixed TypeConverter type parameter order: all built-in converters now correctly use TypeConverter<TProvider, TModel> (provider type first, model type second).
            - Fixed EnumToIntConverter, EnumToStringConverter, DynamicEnumToStringConverter, GuidToStringConverter, ListToJsonConverter type definitions.
            - Fixed Source Generator using FromProvider instead of ToProvider when binding parameters for Insert/Update operations.
            - Fixed ConverterGenerator Setter method incorrectly calling ToProvider when assigning already-converted model values.
            - Fixed DaoCacheGenerator using wrong conversion direction for database parameter binding.
            - Added numeric type conversion in TypeConverterInvoker to handle type mismatches across all providers (SQLite Int64, SQL Server Int32/Int64, PostgreSQL, MySQL).
            - Added legacy data compatibility: string values in database are automatically parsed to numeric types for backward compatibility with older versions.
            - Renamed BoolConverter to BoolToIntConverter and ByteConverter to IntToByteConverter for naming consistency.
            - Updated all documentation examples to reflect correct TypeConverter usage.
            
            0.4.6 (hotfix)
            Fixed:
            - Fixed a codegen bug where DAO Insert methods returning int did not return the execution result in the generated DaoImpl.
            - Improved return-type handling for Insert to support numeric return types (e.g., int, long, and other numeric primitives), ensuring the generated implementation correctly returns the value.
            
            0.4.5
            - Added strict compile-time SQL verification for [Query] (Room-style):
                - Error on unknown tables referenced in FROM/JOIN.
                - Error on unknown columns referenced anywhere in the query (SELECT list, WHERE/ON/SET, ORDER BY/GROUP BY when applicable).
                - Error on missing SQL parameters (e.g., @id/:id without a matching method parameter).
                - Error on parameter type mismatch when compared/assigned to an entity column (e.g., long column vs string parameter).
                - Error on SELECT result type mismatch vs the queried table/entity (e.g., SELECT * FROM documents returning List<Note>).
            - Tooling implemented with incremental, method-scoped analysis to avoid performance regressions.
            
            0.4.4
            - Fluent Migration DX: Column chaining, convenience methods (Id, Timestamps, SoftDelete), and TypeAffinity alias.
            - Programmatic Seeding API: db.SeedAsync() for MAUI/mobile apps, SeederOptions, SeederContext builder pattern.
            - RoomSeeder<TDatabase>: Strongly-typed base class for cleaner seeder implementations.
            - Security: Fixed SQL injection in SchemaGenerator.TableExists() using parameterized queries.
            - Stability: Fixed potential deadlock in ObservableQuery.Publish() with DeliveryMode.All.
            - Fixed compiler warnings CS8509 and CS8601.
            - Updated CLI make:seeder template with new helper methods.
